title: NANSEN dataset scan
description: The result of walking a project's data locations with its Dataset Structure Model config: which roots were read, and the entity records found. Derived and recomputable; kept in cache/scan.nansen.json so the app can show entities without walking the stores again.

path.description: The root as resolved on this machine.

available.description: Whether the root was found and read.

entries.description: Number of listing entries read under the root.

records.description: Entity records as the DSM reader emits them (EntityRecord.schema.json).

unmatched.description: Topmost entries no entity accounts for, as the DSM reader emits them.
